cards.title: Everything that happened, in order
cards.text: 39 on-track passes, 12 pit stops, 3 cars that never finished, 1 safety car.

cards.title: 39 places changed hands on track before the first lap was done
cards.text: 22 cars into the first corner on cold tyres and full tanks.
bullets: Albon gained the most by the end of it, 5 places
cards.note: Most of this is the pack sorting itself out. Some of it decides the sprint.

cards.title: Lawson starts P13. Where does he finish?
cards.text: 19 laps to make up ground from there.
cards.reveal: Somewhere in the points. The exact place comes at the flag.

cards.title: 7 passes on this lap alone
cards.text: Only moves made on track count here, at racing speed.
bullets: 5 different drivers gained a place on this lap
cards.note: Early on, with full tanks and the order still settling.

cards.title: 5 passes on this lap alone
cards.text: Only moves made on track count here, at racing speed.
bullets: 4 different drivers gained a place on this lap

cards.title: Russell takes the lead from Hamilton
cards.text: A pass for the lead, made on track at racing speed.

cards.title: Antonelli: 7 passes
cards.text: More than anybody else out there, in a Mercedes.
bullets: P2 on the grid, P5 at the flag
cards.note: Only moves made on track count, with the car ahead at racing speed.

cards.title: 2 penalties handed out
cards.text: Given by the stewards during the sprint.
bullets: Antonelli: a 10s penalty for causing a collision
Perez: a 5s penalty for safety car infringement
cards.note: A time penalty is served at the next stop, or added to the final time when there is no stop left.

cards.title: One of these three does not see the chequered flag. Who?
cards.text: Nothing on the timing screens says it is coming.
cards.reveal: Hulkenberg, on lap 13 of 19. The timing feed records that he stopped, not why.

cards.title: Sainz hit 351 km/h
cards.text: The trap reads one fixed point on the lap, so a car can go faster elsewhere. And the fastest car in a straight line is often not the fastest car over a lap.
bullets: Sainz did it in a Williams
cards.note: Top speed says as much about wing level, and about sitting in somebody's tow, as it does about the engine.

cards.title: Who has the fastest lap on the board at the flag?
cards.text: It usually lands late, when the car is light and the track has rubber all over it.
cards.reveal: Leclerc on lap 18, 1:34.753, in a Ferrari.

cards.title: Lawson: 10 laps within a second of the car ahead
cards.text: The longest unbroken run like it in the sprint, from lap 2 to lap 11, at racing speed.
bullets: 7 other drivers had a run of five laps or more like it
cards.note: Following closely costs the car downforce and cooks the front tyres, so sitting there is harder than it looks.

cards.title: Lindblad is out
cards.text: His sprint ends on lap 12 of 19, in a Racing Bulls car.
bullets: P22 at the start of lap 11
Started P15
1 on-track pass before it happened

cards.kicker: Your call on the pit wall
cards.title: Safety car with 6 laps left. You are leading. Box or stay out?
cards.text: The pack is about to bunch up behind you and a stop costs far less than usual, except that everybody behind can copy you and anyone who stays out may come out ahead.

choices.label: Box for fresh tyres
choices.sub: Grip for the restart, at the risk of track position

choices.label: Stay out and defend
choices.sub: Keep the lead on older tyres

outcomes.box: New rubber under a safety car is close to free. If the cars behind follow you in, the order holds. If they stay out, your gap has to cover the stop.
outcomes.stay: You keep the lead and restart on older tyres, with a queue of fresher cars in your mirrors and no gap to hide in.

cards.title: 12 stops, all of them on lap 13
cards.text: Once one car stops, the cars around it have to answer.
bullets: Busiest single lap was 13, with 12 cars in under the safety car
Shortest time in the pit lane: Norris, 22.5s
Longest: Antonelli, 33.7s
cards.note: Pit lane time runs from the entry line to the exit line, stop included.

cards.title: Every gap on track, erased
cards.text: The field bunches up behind the safety car, and whatever anybody had built is gone.
bullets: Russell was leading when it came out
He took a stop under it, and so did Leclerc, Norris, Hamilton and 8 others
Neutralised until lap 16
cards.note: A lead built over a long run was worth nothing at the restart, and whoever had fresher tyres underneath him suddenly had a race again.

cards.title: Yellow flags out 3 times
cards.text: Race control waves a yellow for anything on or near the track that should not be there.
bullets: A yellow means slow down and do not overtake in that part of the track

cards.title: Hulkenberg is out

bullets: P16 at the start of lap 12
Started P11
3 on-track passes before it happened

cards.title: Russell had the quickest median racing lap
cards.text: No lap 1, no laps in or out of the pits, nothing behind the safety car or the VSC, and the slow outliers trimmed. It does not always match the result.

cards.title: Hadjar went the other way: 5 places lost
cards.text: Qualifying promised one thing and the sprint delivered another.
bullets: P10 on the grid, P15 at the flag
Qualifying rewards whoever can put one lap together. A sprint asks for 19 of them

cards.title: Lawson: P13 on the grid, P7 at the flag
cards.text: 6 places gained.
bullets: 3 on-track passes along the way
1 car that started ahead of him retired

cards.title: 5 passes on this lap alone
cards.text: Only moves made on track count here, at racing speed.
bullets: 4 different drivers gained a place on this lap
cards.note: Every one of them on track, with no stops around it.

cards.title: Leclerc: 1:34.753
cards.text: The quickest anybody went all sprint, in a Ferrari.
bullets: Set on lap 18 of 19, late on, where they usually land
By then the fuel is nearly gone and the car is at its lightest
A sprint has never paid a point for it

cards.title: How far behind was Leclerc at the flag?
cards.text: 19 laps, about 34 minutes of racing. Put a number on the gap to the winner.

cards.title: Sainz, Gasly, Bearman and 4 others ran one set for 19 laps each
cards.text: The longest anybody stayed out on one set.
bullets: Sainz: hards, lap 1 to 19
Gasly: mediums, lap 1 to 19
Bearman: mediums, lap 1 to 19
Lawson: hards, lap 1 to 19
cards.note: Every lap you stretch is a lap you do not lose in the pit lane. And every lap you stretch is a set of tyres getting slower underneath you.

cards.title: 3 incidents looked at
cards.text: Every one of them logged by race control during the sprint.
bullets: 2 ended in a penalty and 1 in no further action

cards.title: Russell wins it
cards.text: P1 Russell · P2 Leclerc · P3 Hamilton.
bullets: After 19 laps, Leclerc crossed the line 0.674s behind
cards.note: Less than the time it takes to read this sentence.
